overview: One of the relevant options is the BEng (Hons) Electronic Engineering at the University of Technology, Mauritius (UTM) which lists a four year full time program. The University of Mauritius also offers a four-year BEng (Hons) Electrical and Electronic Engineering for the academic year 2026-2027. These are related qualifications so students should look at the curricula of the courses before deciding to take a course specifically in electronics. Students planning to **Study Electronics Engineering in Mauritius** should compare these programs carefully. **Edu-Hawk Worldwide** can help students explore their international study options.

items.q: Can Indian students apply for Electronics & Communication (UG) in Mauritius?
items.a: Yes, Indian students meeting the academic criteria and English proficiency requirements can apply to recognized Mauritian institutions.

items.q: What is the medium of instruction for Electronics & Communication (UG) in Mauritius?
items.a: Programmes at major Mauritian universities are delivered in English, with bilingual options available at select institutions.

items.q: What are the typical tuition fees for Electronics & Communication (UG) in Mauritius?
items.a: Tuition fees generally range between MUR 150,000 and MUR 350,000 per year, offering cost-effective international degree options.

items.q: Is a student visa required for Indian students?
items.a: Yes, international students require an entry permit and student visa issued by the Passport and Immigration Office of Mauritius upon receiving admission.
